name: Descript
description: Descript is an audio and video editing platform built around transcript-based editing, recording, transcription, and collaborative production. Creators and teams use it to edit podcasts and videos, improve speech, generate captions and clips, publish projects, and automate repeatable production work.
agentUseSummary: Enter a personal API token for the intended Descript Drive, then let agents browse projects and run the complete documented API under Safe or Dangerous policy; imports and AI edits consume that Drive's media minutes and AI credits.

credentialRequirements.name: DESCRIPT_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Descript API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated token in Descript Settings > API tokens and bind it to the Drive you want Relay Console to use.

capabilities.label: Browse projects
capabilities.description: List and inspect projects, compositions, publishes, models, and recent jobs in the token's Drive.

capabilities.label: Export transcripts
capabilities.description: Export a project composition as text, Markdown, HTML, RTF, DOCX, or SRT.

capabilities.label: Create and edit productions
capabilities.description: Import media, create projects and compositions, and run Underlord edits that can consume media minutes or AI credits.

capabilities.label: Publish and manage jobs
capabilities.description: Publish compositions, retrieve share and download links, and cancel running jobs.

capabilities.label: Use the complete Descript API
capabilities.description: Use every current documented public API operation authorized by the token and Drive.

allowed.label: List projects
allowed.description: List one bounded page of projects in the token's Drive.

allowed.label: Read project
allowed.description: Read one project's media, compositions, and existing publishes.

allowed.label: List jobs
allowed.description: List one bounded page of recent jobs.

allowed.label: Read job
allowed.description: Read one job's current status and bounded result.

allowed.label: List agent models
allowed.description: Read the live list of available Underlord models and aliases.

allowed.label: Export transcript
allowed.description: Export one authorized composition transcript in a supported bounded format.

approvalRequired.label: Import media
approvalRequired.description: Import media or create a project; this can consume media minutes.

approvalRequired.label: Edit with Underlord
approvalRequired.description: Create or edit a project with Underlord; this can consume AI credits.

approvalRequired.label: Publish project
approvalRequired.description: Publish a composition to a Descript share page and rendered download.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Descript API
approvalRequired.description: Use any current documented public API operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded project, job, model, and transcript reads run directly; imports, AI edits, publishing, cancellation, and other operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token- and Drive-authorized Descript API operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, token secrecy, fixed origin, bounds, audits, plan credits, and provider limits still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Descript Drive API token or eligible signed-in provider session is available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated token for the intended Drive in Descript Settings > API tokens, connect it in Relay Console, then run bounded reads, Safe denial, an approved or Dangerous credit-consuming edit, redaction, token revocation, and disconnect checks.

evidence.supports: Descript documents personal tokens tied to one Drive, one-time token display, API/MCP media-minute and AI-credit consumption, project/import/edit/publish support, and current limitations.

The official Bearer-token API documents projects, jobs, agent models, media import, Underlord edits, publish, transcript export, cancellation, pagination, 402 credit errors, and 429 retry behavior on descriptapi.com/v1.
API access is for paying users without an extra API fee, while usage draws from the customer's own plan credits and media minutes.
